gripOrHq.title: Phone Freak
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put 3 from the bank on Phone Freak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Nomad Allies
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
A, [1]: Remove a tag, at no cost.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Senatorial Field Trip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if the Corp rezzed a piece of Black Ice this turn. The Corp either derezzes that piece of ice or receives 2 Bad Publicity points. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

heapOrArchives.title: Little Black Box
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Prevent up to 1 Net or brain damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Little Black Box when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for increasing your link. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

root.title: Manhunt
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.

root.title: Scorched Earth
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.
